summary: The bad() entry point reads a line from the console and passes it directly as the format string to System.out.format(data), letting attacker-controlled format directives (e.g. %s, %n, %x) be interpreted (CWE-134). The fix uses a constant "%s" format specifier and passes the user data as the argument, so the input is printed verbatim without interpreting percent directives. Legitimate output of the line is preserved.
